description.name: Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Poison] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Marcus
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Tantalus Blade (0~2), removed after using Tantalus Blade two times

description.name: Tantalus Blade Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Tantalus Blade level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Marcus]

description.name: Tantalus Blade Level
description.text: Keeps track of Tantalus Blade level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Marcus]
